en: Black‑and‑white historic postcard showing a large statue of a female allegorical figure (Germania) holding a laurel wreath and sword on a tall pedestal decorated with griffins and coats of arms. The monument stands in a paved urban square surrounded by ornate iron railings, with late‑19th‑century buildings in the background and several people in period clothing in the foreground. The caption and publisher information are printed along the bottom margin.
